title: AI Displacement Risk Screener
description: Port of ApexLogics Apex #104 (AL-111) AI Displacement Risk Screener into the AINumbers chaingraph shape. From a task-composition profile (routine cognitive/manual and non-routine analytical/interpersonal/manual shares), a sector exposure factor, an education level and years in role the node computes a 0..100 composite displacement score (0.40 automation probability + 0.40 routine-task fraction + 0.20 sector exposure, clamped and rounded), an education-adjusted informational score, a Low/Medium/High/Critical tier banding, and up to three adjacent lower-exposure occupations gated at similarity >= 60. SOC lookups use an embedded 62-row table; a null SOC code estimates the probability from the sliders. Automation probabilities are Frey-Osborne 2013-vintage estimates (stale by construction), task splits are Apex-embedded approximations, and the BLS-OES-labelled median-salary cells stayed ungrounded at porting time (BLS HTTP 403): salary figures are informational only and stay out of the score. Port provenance: Apex page https://apexlogics.org/tools/104-ai-displacement-risk-screener/ fetched 2026-10-13 (sha256 68D2AA10A6B93A7E31C8E10FDDCACEFDBD661EF330951A6BF1FC25572F891D18), tasking APEXPORT-104 (GRADES PASS-PENDING-XV 2026-10-18, Builder-verifies-at-land 18/18 vectors), landed by APEX-PORT-104-LAND-1 on 2026-10-18.

soc_code.description: 6-digit SOC code key into the embedded 62-row table; null selects the custom-occupation estimate branch (Apex L480-488). Optional: only this input is conditionally dereferenced.

rc.description: Routine Cognitive share 0..100 (slider t_rc, Apex L470; parseInt read).

rm.description: Routine Manual share 0..100 (slider t_rm, Apex L471; parseInt read).

nra.description: Non-routine Analytical share 0..100 (slider t_nra, Apex L472; parseInt read).

nri.description: Non-routine Interpersonal share 0..100 (slider t_nri, Apex L473; parseInt read).

nrm.description: Non-routine Manual share 0..100 (slider t_nrm, Apex L474; parseInt read).

sector_exp.description: Sector exposure factor (select sector, Apex L475; parseFloat read). Apex option values 0.22..0.75.

ed_level.description: Highest education (select edLevel, Apex L476; informational education adjustment only, Apex L499-500).

years_role.description: Years in role (input yearsRole, Apex L477; parseInt read; recorded, not in the arithmetic).
